claim_ceiling: The current implementation supplies a local AD Hamiltonian-flow Jacobian, a propagated canonical fundamental matrix, finite-observer null-shell screen seeds, and a finite source-ZAMO screen map. It does not yet localize caustic roots, classify fold/cusp catastrophes, perform wave-optics diffraction, or establish a global error certificate.

architecture.discovery: Symthaea proposes candidate structures and model-discrimination hypotheses; semantic/HDC similarity is not physical validation.
architecture.exact_physics: Symtropy evaluates Kerr metrics, canonical null geodesics, variational flow and source-screen maps.
architecture.independent_verification: Analytic Schwarzschild identities, separated Carter equations, neighbouring-ray finite differences, chart-overlap checks and external references.
architecture.provenance: Mycelix-ready receipts should bind exact inputs, source SHA, solver options, output digests and qualification tier.
architecture.visualization: Sol-Atlas consumes qualified trajectories, screen maps, uncertainty and caustic candidates without upgrading evidence status.

screen_frame_policy.status: same-event SO(2) source-screen re-expression implemented; parallel-transported Sachs frame and across-event atlas remain not implemented
screen_frame_policy.topology: An orthonormal tangent frame cannot be chosen globally continuously over the full observer sky S^2; use overlapping local charts or a transported screen frame.
screen_frame_policy.current_source_observation: local_sky_tangent_basis selects between two reference axes at abs(azimuthal_direction)=0.9. The resulting bases are co-oriented, so an ideal chart transition is in SO(2), but the displayed 2x2 components can jump at the seam.
risks: component-wise interpolation across a chart seam can produce a false discontinuity
fold/cusp normal-form coefficients are frame-dependent unless the same oriented screen frame is used
the determinant and singular values are invariant under an orientation-preserving SO(2) row rotation, but this must be tested rather than assumed for a computed transition
requirements: record the source-screen basis chart for every optical-map sample
compute and record the same-event SO(2) chart transition matrix
assert signed determinant and singular values are invariant under the transition
for comparisons across distinct source events, use a parallel-transported Sachs screen basis rather than dotting basis vectors from unrelated local tetrads
refuse a fold/cusp classification when the screen-frame transition is unresolved
implemented_checks: construct the two-dimensional transition from source and target 3D basis rows
reject reflections and non-orthogonal screen bases
apply J_target=R*J_source and recompute determinant, singular values and conditioning
authored_tests: rotating a screen basis preserves signed determinant, both singular values and condition number
remaining: store and validate source-event and photon-direction identity rather than relying on caller contract
parallel-transport Sachs screen basis across source events
continuous atlas transition across the observer-sky seam
fold/cusp classification remains blocked until transported-frame and independent Sachs-Jacobi checks pass

caustic_qualification_policy.candidate_definition: A small sampled determinant is not a caustic. A candidate must be localized as a rank-deficient optical map with a converged smallest singular value and stable source-screen gauge.
simple_fold_requirements: the optical Jacobi map has rank one at the candidate within a scale-aware residual
the determinant has a simple zero along a defined transverse control parameter or affine family, with a converged signed derivative
the nonzero singular value remains bounded away from zero
the null direction and caustic normal are continuous under source-screen SO(2) re-expression
the root is stable under tighter trajectory and variational tolerances and independent affine-step refinement
cusp_requirements: fold degeneracy condition plus vanishing first derivative of the caustic mapping along the critical direction
nonzero next-order derivative satisfying the declared cusp normal-form nondegeneracy condition
two-dimensional source/observer parameter continuation rather than classification from a single affine trace
classification stable under chart changes and parameter-grid refinement
root_localization_requirements: bracketed scalar root solve only after establishing a sign-changing simple-root bracket
for non-sign-changing or even-multiplicity candidates, minimize the smallest singular value and validate the local normal form; do not use sign-change-only detection
integrate the variational system at the refined parameter rather than interpolating raw determinant samples as final evidence
report determinant scale, singular values, condition number, bracket width, root residual, refinement history and unresolved status
prohibited_shortcuts: classify a caustic when abs(det(J)) is merely below a fixed absolute threshold
interpolate matrix components across the sky-basis chart seam without an SO(2) frame transition
report a caustic coordinate before the exact Schwarzschild map and independent Sachs-Jacobi formulation agree
turn an unresolved near-singular matrix into a finite magnification by clipping the smaller singular value
